data.name: Obed
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root ‘abad’, meaning ‘to serve’. In the Old Testament, Obed is a name given to several characters, most notably a son of Boaz and Ruth and a king of Edom. The name symbolizes a servant or worshiper of God.

data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Obed are adventurous, independent, and driven. They are quick thinkers and have the ability to adapt to new situations. They value freedom and hate being tied down.

in_hebrew.name: עובד
in_hebrew.meaning: עובד הוא עובד האלוהים, משרתו הנאמן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עובד הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'עובד האלוהים' או 'משרתו הנאמן של אלוהים'. השם עובד מורכב משתי מילים: 'עבד' שפירושו 'עובד' או 'משרת', ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם עובד מוזכר בתנ'ך כבן של רות והוא אביו של דוד המלך.

in_greek.name: Ὀβήδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὀβήδ (Obed) σημαίνει 'δοῦλος τοῦ Θεοῦ' (doulos tou Theou), ἤτοι 'εὐσεβὴς καὶ ἀφοσιωμένος εἰς τὸ Θεόν'. Ὀβήδ ἦν υἱὸς Ῥουθ καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ βασιλέως Δαυίδ.

in_latin.name: Obed
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Obed derivatur ex Hebraeo 'עובד' (Obed), quod significat 'servus Dei' vel 'ministrus Dei'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Obed fuit gestum a fidelibus qui devotionem suam erga Deum demonstrabant.

in_english.name: Obed
in_english.meaning: Faithful servant of God, worshipper of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Obed originates from the Hebrew 'עובד' (Obed), meaning 'servant of God' or 'worshipper of God'. In the Bible, Obed is the son of Ruth and the grandfather of King David. The name Obed symbolizes devotion, loyalty, and faithfulness to God. Throughout Christian tradition, Obed is regarded as a name that embodies humility and servanthood.

biblical_reference.note: Obed is the son of Boaz and Ruth, and the father of Jesse.
